test_scenario: test the meltingpot scenario module by running scenario tests for all registered scenarios
build_scenario_env: build a meltingpot scenario environment using scenario.get_factory(name).build()
get_scenario_factory: get a scenario factory by name from the meltingpot scenario module
test_scenario_specs: test that a scenario environment matches action, reward, discount, and observation specs
test_permitted_observations: test that a scenario only uses permitted observations from the meltingpot scenario module
